name: studio-code
description: Build, design, and manage WordPress sites with WordPress Studio: create local sites with Studio's design workflow, open your Studio and WordPress.com sites from the WordPress tab, preview them, and publish to WordPress.com.

interface.longDescription: Build WordPress sites from a conversation: Studio creates the site on your computer, asks about the look and layout with rendered previews, generates the imagery, builds a block theme and checks the result visually. The WordPress tab lists your local Studio sites and your WordPress.com sites, with a page per site to start it, open WP Admin, run speed and SEO audits, or work on a live site. Publish to WordPress.com when you are ready. Studio installs itself the first time and keeps itself up to date.
defaultPrompt: Build a WordPress site for my bakery
